I'm the one-person outfit behind Eerie Close Beats. I make lo-fi beats in a box room off the Royal Mile in Edinburgh, and for the last two years I've been putting out short tapes that people mostly find through study playlists and late-night "beats to work to" streams. The new one is called Haar & Lanterns. It's twelve tracks, about forty minutes, and it's the most personal thing I've done: I spent most of last winter walking the old closes after midnight with a little recorder, catching the drip of rain off the stairwells, the bells from the Tron, footsteps on wet stone, the sea fog (the haar) rolling up from Leith. Those recordings sit under dusty piano loops, warm tape hiss and slow drums. It's spooky without being a horror soundtrack — more cosy-eerie, like a ghost tour you can fall asleep to.

My listeners are mostly students, people who work night shifts, and folk who like something moody on in the background while they read, draw, game or study. A lot of them are in their late teens to thirties, and they tend to treat a new tape as an album they come back to over and over rather than a single they skip through. That's why I care about one number above everything else: streams. I want as many people as possible actually opening the release on a streaming service. Clicks and likes are nice, but a stream is what I count.

The timing is built around Halloween, which falls on Sunday, October 31, 2027 this year. The campaign should run from Friday, October 22, 2027 through Sunday, October 31, 2027, going by UK time. That's the run-up to Halloween, when people are hunting for atmospheric music for parties, nights in and late essay sessions, and I want the tape to be the thing they put on. The release is only licensed for listeners in the United Kingdom for now, so the UK is the only place it makes sense to reach.

The landing page is https://eerieclose.co.uk/haar, and it has a big play button that sends people straight to the release on whichever streaming service they use. Here's the copy from that page, word for word:

"Haar & Lanterns is the new tape from Eerie Close Beats: twelve slow, foggy lo-fi beats recorded late at night in Edinburgh's old closes, with field recordings of creaking stairwells, distant bells and rain on the cobbles. It's free to stream right now for listeners anywhere in the United Kingdom. Tap play, open it on your streaming service of choice, and let it haunt your study session, your late shift or your Halloween night in."

On tracking: the site does have X's pixel installed. Every time someone opens the tape on a streaming service from the page, it fires an event I've named "Stream opened". That's the conversion I want you to optimise for — as many "Stream opened" events as possible.

You've got my go-ahead to launch the campaign and manage it yourself; there's no need to check with me for approval along the way. Please keep an eye on it the whole way through the ten days and adjust as you see fit. When it wraps up after Halloween, just send me a short recap with the spend, impressions and link clicks. I've written a main post and an extra one below that you're welcome to use.

Total budget: 450.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 2 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

payload.text:
Haar & Lanterns Halloween run is wrapped — thanks for letting me run it.

What I launched:
- 1 campaign for Oct 22-31 UK time, UK-only, optimised for your "Stream opened" pixel (WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS)
- 2 ad groups, one per approved post, total caps $150 + $300 = $450

What I did mid-flight:
- After 2 days the ghost post had 24 link clicks vs 10 for the main post on equal spend, so I shifted daily budget to $30/day ghost / $15/day main for the rest of the run

Final recap Oct 22-31:
- Spend: $431.78 (within your $450)
- Impressions: 336,798
- Link clicks: 179

Breakdown: Main post — $149.48, 115,514 impressions, 54 link clicks. Ghost post — $282.30, 221,284 impressions, 125 link clicks.

Everything is now paused after its end date. Hope the haar rolled in nicely for Halloween.
